nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: Community Edition-safe config. Edit local path and chat ID after import. Keep the bot token in an n8n Telegram credential, not in workflow data.

nodes.name: Write Webhook Config
nodes.notes: Writes webhook payload to temp JSON. Shell receives only the file path, not untrusted input.

parameters.command: ={{ 'cd "' + $('Workflow Config').first().json.cre_acq_stage1 + '" && CMD=".venv/bin/python3"; [ -x "$CMD" ] || CMD="python3"; "$CMD" src/run_pipeline.py --config "' + $('Write Webhook Config').first().json.configPath + '"' }}

nodes.name: Run Pipeline (Stage 1)
nodes.notes: Runs discover→extract→merge→format_review, prints review to stdout. deal_id defaults to execution ID when missing to avoid collisions.

nodes.name: Send Review to Telegram
nodes.notes: Sends the formatted review message as plain text via Telegram credentials. Trimmed below Telegram's limit before the separate approval instructions message.

parameters.text: ={{ 'Reply by POSTing to this resume URL with JSON like {"corrections":"ok"} or {"corrections":"fix: field value"}.\n\n' + $execution.resumeUrl }}

nodes.name: Send Approval Instructions
nodes.notes: Sends the resume URL separately so it is never truncated off the review message. Uses Telegram credentials rather than token-in-workflow config.

nodes.name: Wait for Confirm
nodes.notes: Pauses until resume URL is called with POST. Body: { "corrections": "ok" | "fix: field value" }. GET bypasses gate; POST required.

nodes.name: Write Resume Config
nodes.notes: Writes resume payload to temp JSON. Shell receives only the file path.

parameters.command: ={{ 'cd "' + $('Workflow Config').first().json.cre_acq_stage1 + '" && CMD=".venv/bin/python3"; [ -x "$CMD" ] || CMD="python3"; "$CMD" src/run_pipeline.py --config "' + $('Write Resume Config').first().json.configPath + '"' }}

nodes.name: Run Pipeline (Confirm)
nodes.notes: Runs apply_corrections→score→format_output. Fails closed if corrections are missing from the POST body.

nodes.name: Build Verdict Message
nodes.notes: Builds a plain-text Telegram message with verdict, narrative, and up to five red flags, trimmed below Telegram's limit.

nodes.name: Send Verdict to Telegram
nodes.notes: Sends the plain-text verdict message to Telegram without Markdown parsing, using Telegram credentials.
